mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.15% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.15%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
